wild_bet: The raw row-shuffle terminal network suggested a 700-governed terminal code: 700-033, 700-034, and 700-032 were high-support terminal-heavy raw edges, with reverse 033/032-700 also terminal-heavy.
why_it_was_plausible: In the raw complete-row network, 700-033 had 144/128 terminal cells, 700-034 had 113/110, and 700-032 had 94/89; row-internal shuffles did not reproduce the larger terminal network.
decision: kill_as_clean_terminal_governor_candidate; retain only as possible register/copy-family pressure
contrast_with_live_network: The 002/060/820 terminal-governor network survives exact collapse at >=20 cells and >=0.85 terminal share. The 700 family does not.
revival_condition: Only revive if source-family collapse, not raw row count, yields a 700 edge above the same threshold or if a narrower pre-registered register-specific model predicts 700 edge behavior.
